system_source.weights: VGGT-1B (huggingface.co/facebook/VGGT-1B, model.pt), SALAD + DINOv2 for loop detection (upstream scripts/download_weights.sh)

deviations_from_defaults: Input frame rate 10 Hz instead of the recorded 30 Hz (frame_step 3). Upstream README, 'Possible problems' d: very dense input with small motion between frames increases drift, extract frames at a lower rate. The authors' own benchmarks (KITTI) are 10 Hz. Evaluation matches poses by timestamp, so ATE stays comparable.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 97887 MiB
